description: Taboola browser event pixels on /log/3/unip. Taboola documents the en event name on the query. The tfa.js loader is vendor/taboola. S2S postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s.

params.name: en
params.description: It is the event name. Taboola documents verifying event pixels by a unip request that carries `en`.
